import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Revenue by product (bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(product_revenue.index, product_revenue.values)
ax1.set_title('Total Revenue by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(product_revenue.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:,.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales distribution by age group (pie chart)
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales.values, labels=age_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                    startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 11})
ax2.set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 3. Average transaction value by payment method (bar chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
payment_avg = df.groupby('payment_method')['total'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars3 = ax3.bar(payment_avg.index, payment_avg.values)
ax3.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Payment Method', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Payment Method', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=12)
for bar in bars3:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + max(payment_avg.values)*0.01,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in revenue comparison (grouped bar chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
takeaway_labels = {0: 'Dine-in', 1: 'Takeaway'}
df['takeaway_label'] = df['is_takeaway'].map(takeaway_labels)
takeaway_revenue = df.groupby(['takeaway_label', 'size'])['total'].sum().unstack()
takeaway_revenue.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Revenue by Takeaway Status and Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Takeaway Status', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(title='Size', title_fontsize=11)

# 5. Price distribution by product (box plot)
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
product_order = df.groupby('product')['price'].median().sort_values(ascending=False).index
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='product', y='price', order=product_order, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Price Distribution by Product', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price ($)', fontsize=12)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Revenue trend by hour (line chart)
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time']).dt.hour
hourly_revenue = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax6.plot(hourly_revenue.index, hourly_revenue.values, marker='o', linewidth=2.5)
ax6.fill_between(hourly_revenue.index, hourly_revenue.values, alpha=0.3)
ax6.set_title('Hourly Revenue Trend', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12)
ax6.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
